note: All twelve targets are built and verified in the local production build: no console errors, no failed requests and no broken images on any route. source.css is assembled from every capture, and interior routes replay the source's whole #middle subtree.

sharedFoundation.rule: Built once per origin. New pages merge their stylesheets into the shared source.css rather than replacing it; per-page declarations that collide get scoped under the page's route wrapper.

sharedNamespaces.note: Header and Footer currently live under the root page namespace. They are the same on every target, so they move to the shared namespace before parallel page work begins; the / route keeps importing them from the new location.

fallbackRoute.purpose: The 139 distinct source pathnames reduce to the targets below; every pathname not cloned renders the shared header and footer with a notice instead of leaving the clone or 404ing.
fallbackRoute.note: Static routes take precedence over the catch-all, so each cloned page still wins.

collisionCheck: Every pageKey, route file, artifact root, component root, asset root and downloader filename below is distinct; no target's pathname collides with an existing route.
linkPolicy: Anchors that resolve to the source origin are rewritten to bare pathnames so navigation stays inside the clone: a cloned route renders, anything else falls through to the catch-all. Other hosts, mail and phone links are left as the source had them.
